name: local-coding-agent
description: Local AI coding agent powered by Ollama and Qwen3-Coder

localCodingAgent.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama server URL used by the Local Coding Agent.

localCodingAgent.model.description: Default Ollama model used by the Local Coding Agent. Overridden per-session by the model picker in the chat view.

localCodingAgent.keepAlive.description: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded in memory between requests (Ollama's keep_alive param, e.g. '30m', '1h', '-1' to keep forever). Higher values give faster responses after the first message by avoiding model reloads.

localCodingAgent.includeActiveFileByDefa.description: Whether the currently open file is attached as context to new chat messages by default. Can be toggled per-message in the chat view.

localCodingAgent.contextLength.description: Context window (Ollama num_ctx) used for chat requests. Agent mode needs room for tool definitions and file contents; lower it if your machine runs out of memory.

localCodingAgent.maxAgentSteps.description: Maximum number of model/tool round trips the agent may take for one message in Agent mode.

localCodingAgent.commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Commands the agent runs (after your approval) are stopped after this many seconds.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.vsix: npm run package && vsce package --out local-coding-agent.vsix
